'''Jerrold Howard Zar''' (June 28, 1941 – April 2, 2026) was an American biologist and academic who was Professor Emeritus at [[Northern Illinois University]], having been elected as Fellow to the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.aaas.org/fellow/zar-jerrold-h |title=Zar, Jerrold H. |publisher=aaas.org |accessdate=April 22, 2017 |archive-date=April 23, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170423160515/https://www.aaas.org/fellow/zar-jerrold-h |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://niu.edu/biology/about/faculty/zar/index.shtml |title=Jerrold H. Zar |publisher=niu.edu |accessdate=April 22, 2017}}</ref>

==Life and career==
Zar received the BS degree in 1962 from [[Northern Illinois University]]. He received a MS (1964) and PhD (1967) both from the [[University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Faculty website for Jerrold H. Zar, Department of Biological Sciences |url=https://www.niu.edu/clas/biology/about/faculty/zar/index.shtml |website=Faculty and Instructors |publisher=Northern Illinois University |access-date=9 November 2023}}</ref>

He wrote a widely cited textbook in [[biostatistics]].<ref>{{Cite book |last=Zar |first=Jerrold H. |title=Biostatistical Analysis |publisher=Prentice-Hall |year=1999 |isbn=9780130815422 |edition=4th}}</ref>

Zar died in [[DeKalb, Illinois]], on April 2, 2026, at the age of 84.<ref>{{cite web |title=Jerold H. Zar |url=https://www.finchfuneralhomedekalb.com/obituary/jerrold-zar |website=Finch Funeral Home & Crematorium |access-date=4 April 2026}}</ref>
